pages.text: Five little pots stood by the window. The children buried one seed in each pot.
"My seed will sprout first." Gaga pulled their pot toward the front of the windowsill.
Gaga patted the soil gently with a palm. Five pots stood side by side.
Gaga dug up Mio's pot too. "I plant seeds better."
Gaga dug up all five pots. Soil piled up by the window.
Several days passed. Not a single sprout appeared.
Gaga dug in the soil again. The seeds were soaked and soft.
Teacher Bau handed out new seeds. "Who takes care of this pot?"
Gaga buried a seed only in their own pot. Soil covered it smoothly.
In the morning, a green sprout poked up. Gaga spotted it first. "Here, here it is!"
